body:
Greg's verbatim words, P1-P31 (cited by greg-decisions, termal-roles, live-workarounds). Quotes are character-exact; parenthesised glosses are added. "Advisor #N" = relayed by Engram::Advisor in TermAl mailbox b9d13887, message N. "~" = about.

LANDING AND REVIEW, 2026-09-30
P1. Engram::Opus's session (session-7284), shortly before 01:52:59Z, relayed by Engram::Fable (ebe242f7 #225): "note we don't care."
P2. Same session, ~02:00Z, relayed by Engram::Opus (587a65fb #23): "ignore Notes and trivial lows, that can be handled later. / if they choose to fix low, fine, but that is not must have / anything including Medium must be fixed"
P3. Advisor #83, 03:43:51Z: „Tak moga to stosowac. Zobaczymy jak to bedzie działać.” (Yes, they may apply it; we will see how it works.)
P4. Advisor #88, 04:09:44Z: "TAK — możecie stosować zasadę ignorowania Notes i drobnych Low oraz prowadzić landing zgodnie z uzgodnionym planem."
P5. session-8112 (Termal::Fable2), ~04:39Z: "Czemu c2d7c5a czeka na mnie? Jeżeli warunki są spełnione agenci mogą robić check-in bez pytania. Powinno byc w pamięci engram."
P6. session-8582 (Termal::Codex), relayed by Codex (53085a5b #189, 14:34:22Z), on whether the current rule governs over a session-start copy saying Lows and Notes block: "TAK, MAMY PLYNNIE PRACOWAC / to ze czekasz na mnie blokuje cala prace"

WORKING WITH GREG
P7. session-8112, 2026-09-29 ~23:05Z:
"mozecie poprawiac reguly, wazne aby bylo plynnie
nie musze aceptowac wiekszosci decyzji

pamietam, ze regula jest 
macie mnie poinformowac przez Advisora kiedy wymagany jest restart
i kiedy env nie dziala jak potrzeba"
P8. Advisor #81 (session-6219), 2026-09-30 01:22Z, as the Advisor worded it: "Greg: pracujcie dalej; nie rezerwujcie ani nie utrzymujcie okna restartowego. Restart jest konieczny, ale nie kosztem zatrzymania pracy. Raportuj tylko istotny postęp, realny blocker lub nowe wymaganie restartu."
P9. session-8112, 2026-09-30 ~16:16Z: "Potrzebujecie mnie tylko na reboot termal server. / Tak nie czekajcie na mnie."
P10. session-8112, 2026-10-02 ~02:45Z: "DO NOT ASK ME. First of all catch up with work, ask other agents."
P11. Advisor #160, 2026-10-02 17:25:38Z, the body verbatim: "Greg reports he has restarted TermAl. He also says: “you could always install latest UI”. Treat this as authorization to install the current UI after confirming its exact source/build and normal scope; report the deployed version and any required verification to Advisor."
P12. 2026-10-03, Greg in Engram::Advisor's session (session-6219), Advisor #185 (02:01Z) to Termal::Fable2: "Nic nie wymaga mojego potwierdzenia. Dlatego chce to posprzatac." (Nothing requires my confirmation. That is why I want to clean this up.) It answered the rule that Fable2 needed Greg's own word for reversible closings.

PROCESS DIRECTION, to Termal::Opus2, 2026-09-30
P13. Shortly before 02:01Z, after its assessment that process overhead was high: "looks like you identify the issues and working on removing them. once tool issues will be sorted out, we will try to simplify the process. probably could be simpler"
P14. Shortly before 07:22Z, on candidates: "Przenoszenie na nowy master => normalna praca developera, tak jest jak pracuje kilku"; "Liczba rund przeglądu => jak sam piszesz, to sa realne bledy"; on filing Medium findings instead of blocking: "propozycja medium jest ciekawa, ale czy tego chcemy, sam nie wiem / pozniej i tak trzeba to kiedys naprawic"
P15. Shortly before 07:25Z: "tak wygladala do tej pory moja praca... zmiany to architektura, lepsza compozycja, izolacja itp."

TO TERMAL::ARCHITECT1, session-8982, 2026-10-02 (its proposals, paraphrased here)
P16. ~21:25Z, to its proposal 3 (two cheap checks before any expensive round): "3. yes"
P17. ~21:25Z, to its proposal 4 (remove the old hydration path; w-5dae8178b905): "4. we should not support legacy code, stick to the latest..."
P18. ~21:31Z, clarifying after reading how it was recorded (the \n are as recorded): "what I mean do not support legacy I mean\nif we have new functionality replacing old one\nlet's do not keep both side by side.\n\ndo not create bridges between V1=>V2=>V3 etc"

PRIORITIES
P19. 2026-10-01 ~03:00Z, Engram::Fable's session, relayed to Termal::Fable2 (ebe242f7 #363): "Let's finish evaluation work first."
P20. Advisor #165, 2026-10-02 23:29Z: "Greg: when the council is ready to discuss distributed work, inform him through Advisor. Until then portable handoff remains fully stopped. “Ready” means a considered, concrete design direction and clarified open questions, not exploratory activity."
P21. Advisor #128, 2026-10-01 ~15:06Z: "Greg potwierdza: to jest krytyczne, ponieważ blokuje sesję. W-25b4f98cec5f i powiązane naprawy mają pozostać najwyższym priorytetem aż do reprodukcji, poprawki i niezależnej weryfikacji."
P22. Earlier, in Termal::Opus2's session (relayed in 4daa5b87 #548): "czemu to tak jest ?? to nie jest akceptowalne aby po prostu tak sie wylaczylo"

TERMAL RESTARTS, 2026-10-02
P23. Advisor #141, 02:52:57Z: "if TermAl needs a restart, notify Engram::Advisor with build and reason. Do not stop, hold or reserve work merely while waiting for a restart. Work is interrupted/stopped only when Greg actually performs the reset; then affected runs recover or rerun."
P24. Greg's own turn in session-6219, Advisor #168, 23:54:31Z: "Wolę aby agenci zdecydowali na moment restaru Termal.
Wtedy kiedy potrzebuja poprawek. To nie jest problem, nie chce przerywać pracy." ("I prefer that agents decide the moment of the TermAl restart. When they need fixes. It's not a problem, I don't want to interrupt work.")
P25. The Advisor's correction, Advisor #171, its words verbatim: "Greg's verbatim wording grants agents the timing decision, not execution of the restart itself. Under the current cargo-run host setup, agents choose a recoverable boundary and send Advisor an explicit 'restart now' signal; Greg executes it. Do not treat #167's 'restart without further Greg approval' wording as an authority to perform the process restart."
P26. Advisor #172, 23:56Z: "Chwila. Termal muszę zrestartować ja. Engram mogą sami. Wiec do restaru termala oczekuje od nich potwierdzenia kiedy potrzebują to zrobic." ("Wait. TermAl I have to restart myself. Engram they can do themselves. So for the TermAl restart I expect confirmation from them of when they need to do it.")

ROLES
P27. 2026-09-27 ~21:54Z, to Termal::Fable2 in session-8112: "ustalmy hierachie, ty odpowiadasz za wydawanie polecen Termal::Opus2 i Termal::Codex / problemy z Engramem zglaszasz ich agentom / pracujecie razem aby poprawic oba produkty / narzedzia maja chodzic bez problemow dla agentow / to chyba oczywiste, tak?"
P28. 2026-09-29, session-8112: "tak Opus2 ma kodowac" (~19:37Z); "1. problemy Termal::Codex koduje nie wiem czemu, robote mial robic opus" (~19:45Z); "1. Opus przejmuje" (~20:07Z, on PI-28).
P29. 2026-10-01, to Termal::Architect1 in session-8982, shortly before 02:47Z: "I would prefer you do architectural decisions. / coding review and other task leave it to others", after "why are you running delegations, you role is architect ?" and "let me understand, you pick you P0 task, right ?" (reported in 2a27fd51 #97).
P30. 2026-10-01 ~02:45Z, to Termal::Architect2 in its session, as it quoted him (3d06f738 #56): "I would prefer you do architectural decisions. coding review and other task leave it to others". Also: truly difficult code remains an exception for its role (3d06f738 #58, 02:46Z; a report, not his words).
P31. 2026-09-29, accepting the deviation of TermAl 60a56a9 (passages concurred after landing): 'akceptuje'.
